title: haex-hive Consumer Manifest v3
description: Schema for a consumer repository's `.haex-hive.json` v3 file. Renames v2 `atoms[]` to `compounds[]` and per-entry `includes[]` to `molecules[]`. See Spec 013.

haex_hive_version.description: Schema version. Must be the exact string "3".

haex_hive_min_version.description: Minimum CLI version required. Grammar: X.Y.Z or >=X.Y.Z.

compounds.description: The explicit allowlist of source-pinned molecule bundles this project inherits (renamed from v2 `atoms[]`). Empty allowed; per Principle V, an empty list inherits no external content.

groups.description: v1 carry-over; not consumed by v3 commands.

moleculeId.description: Reverse-DNS identifier for a molecule (renamed from v2 atomId; shape unchanged).

canonicalSourceUrl.description: Credential-free canonical https:// or ssh:// URL: lowercase host, non-empty path, no trailing slash, and no terminal .git.

track.description: Optional non-authoritative branch annotation. Never overrides revision.

molecules.description: Renamed from v2 `includes[]`. Reverse-DNS molecule ids adopted from this source at this revision.

config.description: Per-molecule-id config overrides. Keys must be molecule-ids listed in this entry's molecules array.

priority.description: Consumer-owned priority override. Publisher config_schema MUST NOT declare a top-level priority property.

values.description: Deep-merged onto publisher defaults; validated against publisher config_schema after merge.
